nodes.label: Auth Cover Image (cover-auth.webp)
nodes.description: Wide 2752x1536 lifestyle photo: a smiling young Asian family (father, mother, small daughter with string lights) standing in a bright, sunlit living room of a newly moved-into home, surrounded by cardboard moving boxes, a rolled rug, potted plants, and a floating shelf being installed. Warm neutral palette (cream walls, beige curtains, wood floor).
nodes.rationale: Filename indicates use as the visual cover/hero for authentication (login/register) screens; the move-in family scene conveys the emotional payoff of a successful KPR (home mortgage), reinforcing trust and aspiration at sign-up.

nodes.label: New Home Ownership / Move-in Moment
nodes.rationale: Depicts the end goal of the KPR journey: a family settling into their own home, used as aspirational brand imagery.

nodes.label: Auth Screen Hero Visual
nodes.rationale: Inferred from 'cover-auth' filename: decorative cover image placed beside or behind the login/registration form; wide aspect ratio suits a split-screen desktop layout.
